notes: Character → Best in slot is now the BiS planner. The set stands like the character window: the slots on both sides and its stats in the middle - attributes, attack power, crit, hit against its cap, haste, spell power, mana per 5 - with raid buffs on or off and each stat against what you wear now. After a change the stats show what moved.

Press a slot for the items that fit it: the list's ones and any item of the item base, by name, each with what it adds or takes away and a score by your spec's weights; where an item comes from opens under it. Enchants have their own panel from the enchant line of a slot.
A two-hand weapon leaves the off hand empty. Hunters choose their ammunition.
Set bonuses: which ones work with the set and which pieces you still need.
Keep a set under a name, make it the plan again later, and compare your set with the lists and your other sets, stat by stat. Any class can be planned.
Below the set: where it all comes from, grouped by dungeon, quests, crafts, reputation and vendors, with the enchants.
Hover any item for its stats, even before the game or the web has described it.
In the game (addon 0.8.2) the tooltip of an item of your set names its slot and the sets it belongs to.
